history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that all closing missions produce a comprehensive lessons learned report to be submitted to United Nations Headquarters upon their closure.
history.administration_response: The Department of Peace Operations conducted a comprehensive lessons learned exercise to review MINUSMA support for the peace process in Mali throughout its decade-long deployment. The exercise concluded with a seminar to assess the legacy of the Mission and derive lessons relevant to the future of United Nations peacekeeping operations. The Department will undertake similar efforts for future closing missions, as relevant and appropriate.
history.board_assessment: The Board acknowledges the work done on the lessons learned from MINUSMA. The recommendation is considered implemented.
